<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.18"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="27" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">9:41</text>
    <line x1="313" y1="23" x2="317" y2="23" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="20" x2="320" y2="23" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="17" x2="324" y2="23" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="14" x2="328" y2="23" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="341" cy="20" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="338" y1="20" x2="344" y2="20" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="354" y="15" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="357" y="18" width="15" height="5" rx="1.5" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="377" y="18" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="42,77 32,87 42,97" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="33" y1="87" x2="57" y2="87" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="76" y="93" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Account Recovery</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Decorative recovery illustration -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="190" r="68" fill="#24272B"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="190" r="52" fill="#30343A"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="190" r="35" fill="#1877F2" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect x="171" y="184" width="48" height="38" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <path d="M180 184 C180 165 210 165 210 184" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="201" r="5" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="205" x2="195" y2="213" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M145 154 C156 137 174 128 195 128" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.7"/>
    <path d="M245 226 C234 243 216 252 195 252" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.7"/>
    <circle cx="145" cy="154" r="4" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <circle cx="245" cy="226" r="4" fill="#1877F2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Form copy -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="302" font-family="Poppins" font-size="24px" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Forgot Password?</text>
    <text x="24" y="331" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Enter your email or mobile number to</text>
    <text x="24" y="353" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">receive instructions to reset your password.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Input -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="391" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Email or mobile number</text>
    <rect x="22" y="401" width="346" height="52" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="24" y="399" width="342" height="52" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="425" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="53" y1="431" x2="59" y2="437" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="72" y="431" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#A0A3BD">you@example.com or +1 555 012 3489</text>
    <text x="24" y="473" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">We'll send a secure reset link or verification code.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Submit button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="503" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="534" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Submit</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Support card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="579" width="342" height="72" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.15"/>
    <rect x="24" y="577" width="342" height="72" rx="6" fill="#24272B"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="613" r="18" fill="#1877F2" opacity="0.16"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="608" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="53" y1="615" x2="53" y2="620" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="80" y="608" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Need help signing in?</text>
    <text x="80" y="630" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Contact support from the Help Center.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Ghost navigation action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="112" y="674" width="166" height="42" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="700" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Back to Log In</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#24272B"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Explore -->
    <circle cx="48" cy="790" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="54" y1="797" x2="59" y2="802" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="48" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Explore</text>
    <!-- Bookmarks -->
    <rect x="125" y="781" width="14" height="19" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polyline points="128,797 132,794 136,797" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="132" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Saved</text>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="195,781 207,790 207,800 183,800 183,790" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <polyline points="180,790 195,778 210,790" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Home</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="312" cy="787" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="312" cy="799" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="312" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
